items.title: Leidos Holdings (LDOS) Lands $875 Million Navy Network Extension For 650,000 Personnel
items.summary: Leidos Holdings (NYSE:LDOS) secured an $875 million contract extension to modernize and secure Navy and Marine Corps networks. The extended agreement supports global IT infrastructure for more than 650,000 Navy and Marine Corps personnel worldwide. The work ties directly into Leidos' NorthStar 2030 digital modernization agenda across mission IT, cyber, and global connectivity. The $875 million Navy and Marine Corps network extension matters.
